placements.note: Placed at the existing site:soudan-minos-far-detector (owned by fermilab-neutrino-other): no source fetched this session gives a coordinate for a distinct CDMS-specific cavern at Soudan, so the shared Soudan Underground Laboratory site is reused rather than inventing site:soudan-cdms. Start year (2003, the commonly cited year CDMS moved to Soudan) is not independently confirmed by a source fetched this session; only the 2005 (INSPIRE date_started) to 2009 (completed) span is directly sourced.
placements.quote: The Cryogenic Dark Matter Search (CDMS II) experiment, located at the Soudan Underground Laboratory

exposure.quote: A total raw exposure of 612 kg-days was analyzed for this work.

ge_detector_count.quote: uses 19 Ge (~230 g) and 11 Si (~100 g) particle detectors

si_detector_count.quote: uses 19 Ge (~230 g) and 11 Si (~100 g) particle detectors

description.quote: The detectors are grouped into five towers, each tower containing six detectors.
description.value: Five towers, each containing six detectors (disks ~10 mm thick, 76 mm in diameter)

summary.plain: Thirty disk-shaped crystals of germanium and silicon, each about the size of a hockey puck, cooled to below one-twentieth of a degree above absolute zero to catch the faint recoil of a dark matter particle hitting an atom.
summary.technical: 19 Ge (~230 g) and 11 Si (~100 g) ionization-and-phonon detectors, 76 mm diameter x ~10 mm thick disks, grouped into five 6-detector towers, operated below 50 mK at Soudan.

technology.quote: Particle interactions in the detectors deposit energy in the form of phonons and ionization.
technology.value: Cryogenic germanium and silicon detectors reading both ionization and phonon (heat) signals from particle recoils, arranged in towers
